points.name: comp_status
points.description: Compressor run status (true = at least one compressor running)

s223.pattern: EnumeratedObservableProperty on the Compressor via hasProperty

points.notes: Brick 1.4.4 has no Compressor_Run_Status class; the honest mapping is the generic On_Off_Status attached via isPointOf to brick:Compressor (class verified). On multi-compressor units, rules that ask whether ANY compressor is running (RTU-0003) may bind the OR of the individual statuses; RTU-0001 counts rising edges, and an OR UNDERCOUNTS cycling — a lag-compressor start while the lead is already running never moves the OR, so a two-stage unit can short-cycle its lag circuit and read healthy. Bind RTU-0001 per compressor. 223P pattern mirrors sf_status's Binary-OnOff enumeration; no packaged-unit reference instance checked.

points.name: comp_stage
points.description: Active compressor stage (0 = off, 1..N = stage index)

s223.pattern: EnumeratedObservableProperty on the Compressor (or the RTU cooling section) via hasProperty

points.notes: brick:Stages_Status is verified in Brick 1.4.4 ('Indicates which stage a control loop or equipment is in') - an exact fit. Second integer point in the library (after operating_state); stage 0 means no compressor running. RTU-0002 interprets stages 1 and 2 against per-stage baselines and reports stages outside {1,2} as not evaluable via its yStageOk output; hosts with more stages extend by rebinding the baseline constants.

points.name: htg_status
points.description: Heating stage run status (true = gas/electric heat or heating coil active)

s223.pattern: EnumeratedObservableProperty on the heating element (burner, electric heater, or coil) via hasProperty

points.notes: brick:Heating_Start_Stop_Status verified in Brick 1.4.4 (subclass of Start_Stop_Status). Alternative for sites tagging the element itself: generic On_Off_Status isPointOf the burner/heater equipment. For staged gas heat bind the OR of stage statuses - RTU-0003 only asks whether ANY heat is active.
